gancho: On the slopes of Mauna Kea, the snow goddess Poliʻahu races hōlua sleds with her friends, until a beautiful stranger joins in. The stranger is Pele. Fire bursts out of the mountain, Poliʻahu's snow mantle starts to burn, and then the snow strikes back. Based on W. D. Westervelt, Hawaiian Legends of Volcanoes (1916), and Martha Beckwith, Hawaiian Mythology (1940).
capitulos: The maidens of the white mantle
